title.es: Resolver un problema con un servicio

es: Resolver un caso de servicio completo: entender la respuesta de la empresa, redactar la petición final y aceptar, rechazar o negociar una contraoferta.

teaching.en: The company sent a counteroffer: a partial refund instead of a full one.
teaching.es: La empresa envió una contraoferta: un reembolso parcial en lugar de uno completo.
teaching.explanationEs: Una contraoferta cambia lo que pediste; partial ≠ full.
segments: The company sent a counteroffer: a partial
refund instead of a full one.
teaching.audioText: The company sent a counteroffer: a partial refund instead of a full one.

teaching.en: I am afraid I must decline that offer, as it does not cover the repair.
teaching.es: Me temo que debo rechazar esa oferta, pues no cubre la reparación.
teaching.explanationEs: Decline + oferta: rechazo cortés; as da el motivo.
segments: I am afraid I must decline that offer,
as it does not cover the repair.
teaching.audioText: I am afraid I must decline that offer, as it does not cover the repair.

teaching.en: I am willing to settle for a partial refund, on the condition that you repair the machine.
teaching.es: Estoy dispuesto a conformarme con un reembolso parcial, con la condición de que reparen la máquina.
teaching.explanationEs: Settle for + algo: aceptas menos de lo pedido; on the condition that + oración pone tu condición.
segments: I am willing to settle for a partial refund,
on the condition that you repair the machine.
teaching.audioText: I am willing to settle for a partial refund, on the condition that you repair the machine.

teaching.en: To reach a compromise, I can meet you halfway.
teaching.es: Para llegar a un acuerdo, puedo llegar a un punto medio.
teaching.explanationEs: Meet you halfway: cada parte cede algo.
teaching.audioText: To reach a compromise, I can meet you halfway.

teaching.en: Thank you for your counteroffer; I would like to propose one change.
teaching.es: Gracias por su contraoferta; me gustaría proponer un cambio.
teaching.explanationEs: Agradecer primero y proponer después mantiene el tono cortés.
segments: Thank you for your counteroffer; I
would like to propose one change.
teaching.audioText: Thank you for your counteroffer; I would like to propose one change.

teaching.en: We accept your counteroffer in full, so please consider the matter closed.
teaching.es: Aceptamos su contraoferta íntegramente, así que por favor den el asunto por cerrado.
teaching.explanationEs: In full = por completo; al aceptar, cierras el hilo (close the loop).
segments: We accept your counteroffer in full,
so please consider the matter closed.
teaching.audioText: We accept your counteroffer in full, so please consider the matter closed.

prompt.es: Elige qué ofrece la tienda en esta contraoferta.

choices.text: A full refund and no repair.
A partial refund and a free repair.

feedback.es: La tienda devuelve la mitad del precio (reembolso parcial) y repara gratis; no ofrece reembolso total ni máquina nueva.

hint.es: Fíjate en cuánto devuelven y qué más ofrecen.

origin.text: Dear Ms Reyes, we cannot refund the full price. We can refund half the price and repair the machine free of charge next week. Kind regards, Dan

prompt.es: Completa: «Lamento tener que rechazar esa oferta.»

feedback.es: I am afraid I must decline es el rechazo cortés de una oferta.

hint.es: Es el verbo para rechazar con cortesía.

origin.text: I am afraid I must ___ that offer.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me conformaré con un reembolso parcial.»

answer.text: I will settle for a partial refund

feedback.es: Settle for + algo expresa que aceptas una solución menor a la pedida: aquí, un reembolso parcial.

hint.es: Usa settle for antes del reembolso.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con la decisión que expresa.

feedback.es: Cada frase expresa una decisión distinta ante una contraoferta: aceptar, rechazar, proponer un punto medio o poner una condición.

prompt.es: Escucha la respuesta del servicio y elige qué ofrece a cambio.

choices.text: A free repair and a discount, not a new laptop.
A new laptop and a full refund.
A discount only, without any repair.

feedback.es: La empresa no cambia el portátil, pero ofrece repararlo gratis y un descuento en el próximo pedido.

origin.audio: Thank you for your patience. We cannot replace the whole laptop, but we can repair it free of charge and give you a discount on your next order.

prompt.es: Completa: «Necesitamos un acuerdo a medias entre su oferta y mi petición.»

feedback.es: Compromise es el acuerdo a medias en el que cada parte cede algo entre la oferta y la petición.

origin.text: We need a ___ between your offer and my request.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo gestiona el cliente la contraoferta.

choices.text: He accepts it and closes the matter.
He politely rejects it and asks for a full refund.
He asks the company to offer less.

feedback.es: El cliente agradece, rechaza con I am afraid I must decline y explica el motivo; pide en su lugar un reembolso completo.

origin.audio: Thank you for your counteroffer. I am afraid I must decline it, because it does not cover the cost of the repair. I would accept a full refund instead.

prompt.es: Elige la respuesta que negocia sin perder firmeza.

choices.text: I decline half the price and I want nothing.
I accept half the price and you need not repair anything.
I am willing to settle for half the price, on the condition that you also repair the machine.

feedback.es: Solo la primera acepta la parte de la oferta y pone una condición concreta; las otras rechazan todo o renuncian a la reparación.

origin.text: La empresa ofrece devolver la mitad del precio. Tú aceptarías si además reparan la máquina gratis.

feedback.es: In full significa «por completo»: aceptas todos los términos de la contraoferta.

prompt.es: Escribe tu respuesta final: rechaza, propón un acuerdo con condición y fija plazo.

answer.text: Dear Ms Lee, thank you for your reply and for your counteroffer. I appreciate that you have looked at my case. I am afraid I must decline both options as they stand. A refund of half the price would not cover a new laptop, and a repair in three weeks is too long, because I need the laptop for my work. However, I would like to propose a compromise. I am willing to settle for the repair, on the condition that it is finished by Friday 26 June and that you lend me another laptop until then. In addition, I would be grateful for a discount on the repair, as the delay has caused me a lot of inconvenience. I understand that this may be difficult, so I am happy to meet you halfway on the discount. Please confirm your decision by Monday, and I will consider the matter closed once the laptop is back with me. Failing that, I will have to escalate my case to your manager. I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Tom Ruiz

Dear Ms Lee, thank you for your message. I have read your counteroffer carefully, and I understand that you cannot do both things. I am afraid I cannot accept either option as it stands, because half the price would not buy a new laptop and three weeks is too long for me. To reach a compromise, I would settle for a repair, provided that it is done by Friday 26 June. I would also be grateful if you could lend me a laptop until then, as I work from home. If that is not possible, I am willing to meet you halfway and accept a partial refund plus a free repair. Please let me know your decision by Monday, and I will consider the matter closed after the repair. Failing that, I will have to escalate the matter to your manager. I trust that we can resolve this quickly. Kind regards, Tom Ruiz

feedback.es: La respuesta final agradece, rechaza con cortesía, propone un acuerdo con condición y plazo, y cierra con seguimiento o escalada manteniendo la firmeza.

origin.text: Tu portátil se estropeó hace cuatro semanas. La empresa TechCare contestó: «We can refund half the price or repair the laptop in three weeks. We cannot do both.» Escribe 210 a 260 palabras en inglés a la Sra. Lee: agradece su contraoferta, rechaza cortésmente las dos opciones tal como están, propón un punto medio con una condición y un plazo, y cierra con una fórmula de seguimiento o de escalada.

feedback.es: Tras aceptar, el mensaje cierra el tema sin pedir nada más; las otras opciones reabren el conflicto.

origin.text: Has aceptado la contraoferta y quieres cerrar el hilo con cortesía.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué propone la empresa para llegar a un punto medio.

choices.text: The full price back and a new product.
Half the price back now and more later if needed.
No refund, but a free repair.

feedback.es: La empresa propone reembolsar la mitad ahora y el resto solo si la reparación falla: es su punto medio.

origin.audio: We can meet you halfway: a refund of half the price now, and the rest if the repair fails.
